metric.name: heap_growth_objects_by_class
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.memory.heap_graph.heap_graph_class_aggregation;
SELECT sum(value) AS value FROM (
SELECT type_name AS key, SUM(reachable_obj_count) AS value
FROM android_heap_graph_class_aggregation
WHERE graph_sample_ts = (
  SELECT MAX(graph_sample_ts) FROM android_heap_graph_class_aggregation
)
GROUP BY type_name
HAVING value > 0
ORDER BY key

)

claims.text: Reachable Java objects increased from 432751 in baseline to 434935 in current, a growth of 2184 objects.

claims.text: The object growth is concentrated in a listener-related chain: $Proxy3 grew from 16 to 164, ForwardingPlayer listeners from 17 to 165, ListenerHolder objects from 50 to 198, and the SuperPlayer and FeedRow listener-related lambda classes also grew by 148 each.

citations.sql:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.memory.heap_graph.heap_graph_class_aggregation;
SELECT type_name, SUM(reachable_obj_count) AS objects
FROM android_heap_graph_class_aggregation
WHERE graph_sample_ts = (SELECT MAX(graph_sample_ts) FROM android_heap_graph_class_aggregation)
  AND type_name IN ('androidx.media3.common.util.ListenerSet$ListenerHolder','androidx.media3.common.ForwardingPlayer$ForwardingListener','com.superplayer.core.SuperPlayerKt$$ExternalSyntheticLambda0','com.superplayer.demo.FeedScreenKt$FeedRow$1$1$1$1','$Proxy3')
GROUP BY type_name
ORDER BY type_name

claims.text: Commit 6efb841e56d8071cddf03a32002d8413507b2797 removed the resetForReuse cleanup that removed every wrapped listener from the delegate and cleared wrappedListeners.

The removed listener cleanup directly matches the current-trace growth of proxy, listener-holder, forwarding-listener, and feed-row listener objects, so this commit is the direct attribution for the heap-growth regression.

caveats: Only one capture per side is available, so run-to-run heap variability is not measured.
The selected metric compares reachable objects from the last recorded Java heap-graph sample in each trace; it does not measure retained bytes or prove the full retention path.
